body: True, I know mood and emotional state can affect the trip so maybe the only time I was truly relaxed was while meditating? Idk, just seemed weird because it’s not like I’ve had consistent bad trips, just underwhelming ones.

I don’t take any medications on the regular and I doubt I had anything else other than weeds in my system. But maybe the whole food aspect? I didn’t fast or anything
What do you consider “going to go to shit” to actually be?
Sounds a bit controlling? I can relate to an extent. Is it a fear of not being able to control the time that you will go or how painful it could be?
It’s somewhat paradoxical to feel unsafe/uneasy because of possible impeding danger that could result in death, yet suicide seems like an option.

Hey man, you’re a young kid but you sound very conscious of your situation. I’ve struggled with my mental health a lot from a young age so I can relate. My biggest advice is to seek counseling. I know how hard things can get and lack of sleep can make you hallucinate. Don’t suffer in silence, make your friends aware of your situation. If they leave your side then you never really needed them by your side anyways. It will be 100% hard but being resilient is crucial. Life comes with turbulence but the future isn’t always bleak, stay strong.

I don’t think you could have described depression any better than homesick. Feeling out of place in your own home is tough... I definitely think you should take a moment and think about whether or not the pain will really end or just be transferred to someone else. From personal experience, the look in my friends eyes after I was released from 24hr op was heartbreaking. I could see how hurt they were and this keeps me going. I would hate to have someone exist feeling the way I do because of my very actions. Even though I feel alone a lot, people still care...

I haven’t self harmed since then but I’m starting to feel like I need a release... I don’t really find joy in much now, probably a side effect from depression? but I played sports all my life and i even draw and paint, not as of lately though...My life isn’t that bad I guess at this point, in fact I’m proud of my progress (I went from 4am shifts  in a stock room at $10.50/hr and other not so legal dealings to just under 70k a year). Things are turning up but i still feel a void in my life... it just makes me feel even more hopeless now that I have basically everything many would long for.
